name: boolean_precedence
title: 'a and b or c' evaluates as '(a and b) or c', not 'a and (b or c)'
symptom: Boolean logic produces false positives/negatives that are hard to trace
cause: Operator precedence: 'and' binds tighter than 'or', so the expression is (a and b) or c
fix: Add explicit parentheses to make the intended grouping unambiguous
mal_code: if a and b or c:  # means (a and b) or c
